# rule: take largest 8-conn non-bg comp; bbox; recolor ALL its cells to dominant color (4); output bg elsewhere.
def solve(g):
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps8(g,bg)
    c=max(cs,key=len)
    ys=[r for r,_ in c]; xs=[x for _,x in c]
    r0,r1,x0,x1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
    dom=Counter(g[y][x] for y,x in c).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[dom if (y,x) in set(c) else bg for x in range(x0,x1+1)] for y in range(r0,r1+1)]
